name: background.raised-by-belief.name
editNote: Reserved Material removed: the example Lore that named a deity is left out. Page 88 prints "steeped in the traditions of a particular deity", "Choose two attribute boosts", and "You're trained in the deity's listed Divine Skill and gain the Assurance feat with that skill. You are also trained in a Lore skill related to your deity"; the source words these differently, and the page's wording is used. Accepted: the boost, the trained skill and the Lore all depend on the deity, so boosts are free/free and the skill is a described choice.
